// diagnostic E3102

Jet.MemoryTierWithoutUse

`{item}` is part of the low-level tier.

What

`{item}` is part of the low-level tier.

Why

Naming `Ptr`, `volatile_read`, or an allocator needs the discovery gate. During `jet check`, Jet reports this diagnostic.

Fix

Add `use core.mem;` at the top of the file.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.MemoryTierWithoutUse: Tests/UI/ffi_asm_no_mem.stderr.

Error: Jet.MemoryTierWithoutUse: Inline assembly is part of the low-level memory tier
  --> Tests/UI/ffi_asm_no_mem.jet:1:38
    |
  1 | #[Unsafe("register-only increment"), FFI(asm)]
    |                                      ^^^^^^^^
 Why: Assembly can read registers and memory outside Jet's safe value model, so discovery requires the explicit `core.mem` opt-in
 Fix: Add `use core.mem` at the top of this file
